kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Hebrew תַּלְמוּד (talmúd, “learning”). Related to تِلْمِيذ (tilmīḏ, “pupil; disciple”), another loanword.
g: Talmud (a collection of Jewish writings related to the practical application of Judaic law and tradition (may refer to either the Babylonian Talmud or the shorter Jerusalem Talmud))
